newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel soars on 1996 profit statement.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel soars on 1996 profit statement.

text.p: Shares in French telecommuncations company Alcatel Alsthom soared almost nine percent on Thursday after the company said it expected profits of roughly 2.5 billion francs ($451.6 million) in 1996, dealers said.
The shares had risen 40 francs to 493 by 1115 GMT after hitting a high of 497.7 francs. Volume was just 1.57 million shares.

Alcatel, which suffered France's worst corporate loss of modern times in 1995, said it expected 1996 net income to be approximately 2.5 billion francs after capital gains from a recovery programme that involves selling non-strategic assets.
